# fco_managed_vm_operating_systems (Data Source)

Lists all operating systems available to the tenant.

Access the results via `fco_managed_vm_operating_systems.<name>.operating_systems`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all operating systems available to the tenant.
data "fco_managed_vm_operating_systems" "all" {
}

# Access with `fco_managed_vm_operating_systems.all.operating_systems`.
# e.g. fco_managed_vm_operating_systems.all.operating_systems[0].uuid
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) A content hash identifying the current set of listed operating systems.
- `operating_systems` (Attributes List) The list of all operating systems available to the tenant. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--operating_systems))

<a id="nestedatt--operating_systems"></a>
### Nested Schema for `operating_systems`

Read-Only:

- `title` (String) The title of the operating system.
- `type` (String) The type of the operating system: `linux` or `windows`.
- `uuid` (String) The UUID of the operating system.
